labels.name: phase:6
labels.description: Roadmap phase 6: Wilderness and team modes

milestones.title: Phase 1: Feel and speed
milestones.description: Make the fight playable and fast: under 12 ms GPU on the M1 Air's own screen, camera v2, melee cones, movement, key remapping, CI.

milestones.title: Phase 2: Looks
milestones.description: Bring the valley to life: ASTC, scatter, post stack, day and night, spell effects, HUD art, crowd rendering.

milestones.title: Phase 3: Characters and economy
milestones.description: Character creator, specialty XP, perks, inventory, loot, shops, bank and trading, all server-side from the start.

milestones.title: Phase 4: Brambleford
milestones.description: The first complete area, solo against the local server: settlement, NPC routines, quests, one dungeon, the Barrow King, streamed world cells.

milestones.title: Phase 5: Online
milestones.description: Standalone Linux server over QUIC, network-ready snapshots, client prediction, accounts and a character database, bots, a hosted test server.

milestones.title: Phase 6: Wilderness and team modes
milestones.description: The Wilderness (PvP and PvE in level bands, real stakes) and no-stakes team modes: dungeons, capture the flag, arenas, parties and matchmaking.

milestones.title: Phase 7: Living world
milestones.description: Gathering and crafting, the AI layer, companions, weather and world events.

milestones.title: Phase 8: Scale and polish
milestones.description: Several world servers and region hand-over, anti-cheat and moderation, full audio, controllers, replay.
